# PhantasyServer inside Nova3K

This folder is a copy of **[PhantasyServer](https://github.com/PhantasyServer/PhantasyServer)** by
**Anton Maltsev**, MIT license (see `LICENSE`), taken at commit `df1994ee75ff7a78fbd8b560d1278fce65d6a0d6`.

Nova3K (by Qwyeltend) uses it to let Phantasy Star Online 2 for PS Vita be played offline: the server runs
inside the emulator on the device. **This would not have been possible without Anton Maltsev's work —
thank you!** The protocol knowledge comes from his
[pso2-protocol-lib](https://github.com/PhantasyServer/pso2-protocol-lib) (MIT / Apache-2.0).

## Changes made for Nova3K

| File | Change | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `master_ship/src/lib.rs`, `ship_server/src/settings.rs` | `Args::parse()` → `Args::parse_from([...])` | The server runs inside the emulator process; its command line is not the server's |
| `master_ship/src/lib.rs`, `ship_server/src/lib.rs` | Logger init error is ignored | Nova3K installs the logger (server lines go to `vita3k.log`) |
| `master_ship/src/lib.rs`, `ship_server/src/{lib,block}.rs`, `data_structs/src/master_ship.rs` | Listen on `127.0.0.1` instead of `0.0.0.0` | Offline play on the device; nothing is opened to the network |
| `master_ship/src/lib.rs` | Vita ship list ports start at `12094` (was `12194`) | The Vita client also queries 12094 |
| `ship_server/Cargo.toml` | Lua 5.1 instead of LuaJIT on Android | LuaJIT does not cross-compile for Android here |
| `ship_server/src/master_conn.rs` | The master ship at `127.0.0.1` is trusted without the interactive "continue connecting?" prompt | Both run inside the emulator, there is no terminal to answer the prompt |
| `ship_server/src/user/mod.rs`, `ship_server/src/user/handlers/quest.rs` | Unhandled client packets and the quest counter steps are logged at info level | Release builds strip debug logs; these lines show in `vita3k.log` what the Vita client asks for (quests could not be taken) |
| `data_structs/src/quest.rs`, `ship_server/src/quests.rs` | New quest field `nova3k_always_unlocked`: such quests are listed for every character without an unlock | A new character only has the first story quest unlocked; the offline quests must be reachable |
| `ship_server/src/map.rs` | Chunks with many spawn points (generated quests) spawn enemies at the point nearest to the player (not closer than 8 units); chunks with few points keep the random choice | The real chunk ids of the generated quests are not known yet, so their chunks list all points of the layout |
| `ship_server/src/map.rs` | On a minimap reveal request the cell the client names (row, column) is revealed as well as the chunk's own reveals | The generated quests do not know the real chunk -> cell table; the minimap stayed empty |
| `ship_server/src/user/handlers/quest.rs` | Every minimap chunk reveal is logged with chunk id, map cell and player position | Gives the real chunk table for the quest generator |
| `data/quests/nova3k/`, `data/enemies/nova3k/` (new) | 15 "Exploration" quests and 114 enemy stat files generated from the PS Vita 6.31 client data (zone layouts, enemy points and species) by Nova3K's `tools/quest_gen.py`; only species that have a client AI module (`enai/ai_*.suprx`) are used; stats are placeholders (multipliers 1.0) | Offline single-player content |
| `ship_server/src/battle_stats.rs` | An attack that is not in `data/attack_stats` no longer drops the hit: it counts as a plain attack (x1.0) of the equipped weapon's type (player) or melee (enemy); every unknown id is logged once | Most PAs, techniques and enemy attacks are not described (e.g. `Rifle:PA2`/`PA3` did no damage) |
| `ship_server/src/user/mod.rs`, `ship_server/src/user/handlers/server.rs` | Handle ReturnToCampship (0x03 0x17), ReturnToCampshipFinal (0x03 0x19), DeathToCampship (0x03 0x1A) -> campship zone; CampshipToLobby (0x03 0x1C) -> lobby | There was no way back from a quest |
| `ship_server/src/user/handlers/chat.rs` | Chat commands `!campship` (`!cs`), `!lobby`, `!abandon` | Always-working way out while the client's own menu packets are being identified |
| `ship_server/src/user/handlers/quest.rs` | TEMPORARY: the quest counter answers with a numbered AvailableQuests (field N = N, all type bits) | With the real answer the 6.31 client says "no quests"; with this one the counter works. To be replaced once the needed field is known |
| `ship_server/src/map.rs` | Interact (0x04 0x14) with an object/NPC that has no Lua script now gets a SetTag answer `<action>Success` (like `Sit` -> `SitSuccess`) and is logged with object id, name and action | Shop / exchange NPCs have no script: the server stayed silent and the client waited forever. (0x04 0x13 is only "player came near / left an object", sent while walking past NPCs, not the talk request) |
| `ship_server/src/quests.rs`, `ship_server/src/user/handlers/chat.rs`, `data/quests/nova3k/20010*/map/map.json` | Chat command `!quests` (quests the server knows, locked or not); Forest Exploration gets the real minimap chunk table from the game log (7 chunks, points per chunk, reveals) | Testing aids; enemies appear ahead along the field |
| `ship_server/src/map.rs`, `ship_server/src/inventory.rs` | Enemy kill loot for every player on the map: 10-40 meseta, Monomate with a 25% chance, straight into the inventory (meseta update, stack update or new item) | The server had no drops at all; ground drops (New Item Drop 0x0F 0x04 + pickup 0x0F 0x01) can come later |
| `ship_server/src/user/mod.rs` | (removed) 0x04 0x13 on campship object 7 -> lobby | Wrong: object 7 is `oa_start_sync`, the dive pool, and 0x04 0x13 is "entered its area" - the pool sent the player to the lobby instead of the quest. The exit is `oa_campship_exit` (object 3) |
| `ship_server/src/party.rs`, `user/handlers/party.rs` | Abandon quest: the party lock is released before the players are moved to the lobby | Entering the lobby reads the party; with the party still write-locked the player froze and the client disconnected after a minute |
| `ship_server/src/user/handlers/quest.rs` | Available quests: real counts, all type bits set (the numbered probe is removed) | The probe showed the 6.31 client reads the counts from the right fields (Free Field = expedition), but the Vita type bits differ, so the real answer listed nothing |
| `ship_server/src/user/mod.rs` | TEMPORARY: every client packet except movement/ping is named in the log (first 3000) | Find unanswered requests (consumables do not heal) |
| `Cargo.toml`, `nova3k_embed/` (new) | Static library with a C entry point `nova3k_pso2_server_start` | Starts master ship + ship server in a thread of the emulator |

---

Это копия **PhantasyServer** (автор **Anton Maltsev**, лицензия MIT). Nova3K (автор Qwyeltend) запускает его
внутри эмулятора, чтобы в PSO2 для PS Vita можно было играть оффлайн. **Без работы Anton Maltsev это было бы
невозможно — спасибо!** Изменения для Nova3K перечислены в таблице выше.
| `ship_server/src/map.rs`, `user/handlers/server.rs`, `user/mod.rs` | MoveZone (0x03 0x05) handled: the quest's warp table (`map_data.warps`, client zone ids) gives the destination zone, else the next zone | The client sends it at a zone gate; the server had no handler, so a quest could never have more than one field zone |
| `ship_server/src/map.rs` | Zone named `boss`: its enemies spawn once when the first player arrives (quest level + 2); when they are dead the quest exit `oa_telepipe_clear` appears at the boss point and every player gets 100 + 25 x level meseta | Boss at the end of a quest and a way out after it |
| `ship_server/src/map.rs` | A player killed by an enemy no longer hits `todo!()` | It panicked the server task (disconnect) |
| `data/quests/nova3k/20010 - Forest Exploration` | Rebuilt with tools/quest_gen_multi.py (research repo) from the full client zone dump: fields 2001 and 0034 (Forest natives: NativeBeast, NativeBeastThrower, WolfB, PterosaurA, ArmadilloA, RagRappyA), boss arena 0400 with BigBeastA (Rockbear), zone gates, warps 0->1->2 | The old single zone (layout 1744) was a Darker incident layout |
| `ship_server/src/user/handlers/object.rs`, `user/mod.rs`, `battle_stats.rs` | MovementAction (0x04 0x08): every new action name is logged once; a name that looks like item use / healing ("item", "mate", "heal", "recover", "drink") heals 50% (Dimate 75%, Trimate 100%) and the new HP goes back as DamageReceive with a negative amount | Monomate played its animation but HP never changed: the server did not answer the action. The exact name is still to be confirmed from the log |
| `ship_server/src/map.rs` | A player at 0 HP also gets the 0x04 0x0F "killed" packet (as enemies do) | With only HP 0 the client kept playing |
| `ship_server/src/inventory.rs` | Loot consumables stack to 10 at most (no new copy when the stack is full) | 12 Monomates piled up in the inventory |
| `ship_server/src/user/handlers/server.rs`, `battle_stats.rs` | Full HP when returning to the campship (death, finished or abandoned quest) | The server kept the player at 0 HP |
| `ship_server/src/inventory.rs`, `user/handlers/object.rs` | Healing takes the used item from the inventory (`MonomateS` action -> Monomate 3/1/0/0; Dimate / Trimate assumed subid 1 / 2) | The Monomate healed but the count stayed the same |
| `ship_server/src/map.rs` | Generated quests: enemies spawn only at layout points within 40 m of the player and within 3 m of its height, else 6-10 m next to the player | Layouts also hold points of closed-off event areas: enemies appeared under the ground / inside rocks |
| `ship_server/src/user/handlers/chat.rs`, `map.rs` | `!next` chat command: next zone of the quest | Testing zones and the boss while the zone gates are not confirmed |
| `data/quests/nova3k/20010 - Forest Exploration/map/objects/fields` | Zone gates are server objects: `oa_transfer_multi` at the layout's zone transfer point and `oa_telepipe_start` at the arrival point (object data copied from the server's captured two-zone quest 50570, whose `oa_transporter_universal` sits exactly on the client set position). Replaces the TransporterSpawn gates (that packet is the campship telepool) | No gate appeared at the end of the Forest field |
| `ship_server/src/map.rs` | Every (object, action) of Interact is logged once; `oa_transfer_multi` / `oa_telepipe_clear` get a SetTag `<action>Success` answer, and a gate action that reads as use (transfer/move/warp/enter/use/goal) moves to the next zone | The gate object was created and the client queried it right away, but nothing appeared: the answer it waits for is unknown |
| `data/quests/nova3k/20010 - Forest Exploration/map/map.json` | LoadLevel describes this quest: `unk40` = 20010 and `unk14` = one entry per zone (310/2001, 310/101, 310/400) instead of the template's quest 50570 zones 392/393; boss-arena telepipe at ground height | Every enemy looked like a Dagan (the client loaded the Darker emergency quest's resources); the arena telepipe floated |
| `ship_server/src/user/handlers/object.rs`, `user/mod.rs`, `map.rs` | Player breadcrumb trail (a point every 4 m, last 96, reset per zone); generated-quest enemies spawn on it 8-25 m from the player. Enemy movement (entity type 6) no longer overwrites the player's position; an enemy reported 12 m below its spawn point 3 times is despawned and spawned again next to the player (logged as `Nova3K enemy rescue`) | Enemies inside walls / under the floor, endlessly falling and resetting |
| `ship_server/src/quests.rs`, `user/handlers/quest.rs`, `map.rs` | Generated quests: enemy level = the player's main class level (boss +2, clear reward 100 + 25 x level); kill meseta 5-15 + 2 x enemy level | Every generated quest was level 5, rewards did not grow |
| `ship_server/src/user/handlers/quest.rs` | Experiment: the 0x0E 0x65 packet sent with the quest counter has its first u32 set to 0 (was 1 in the captured data) | "Emergency Quests" said "no quests" and the counter hung; the 1 may announce an emergency quest that does not exist offline |
| `ship_server/src/battle_stats.rs`, `user/handlers/chat.rs` | Enemy spawn value `unk9[12]` ("model id") comes from `nova3k_model_id(name)`: the values seen in quest 50570 for DpAbyss / DpAbyssChar / DpToy, the old Dagan value 0x5DA08B21 for the rest. `!model <number|0xHEX|off>` overrides it for the next spawns, `!spawn <EnemyName>` spawns one at the player | Every enemy was drawn as a Dagan: the server sent the Dagan value for all of them. The rule for other enemies is not known yet |
| `ship_server/src/map.rs`, `user/handlers/chat.rs` | `nova3k_memscan.req` is written on the first enemy spawn, on the boss spawn and by `!scan`: the emulator then searches the game memory for the known model values and enemy names (log `Nova3K PSO2 memscan`) | Find how the client builds the model value |
| `ship_server/src/map.rs`, `user/handlers/server.rs`, `user/mod.rs`, quest 20010 objects | A second telepipe (`oa_telepipe_start`, object id ending in 5) at the far end of every field: using it (ReturnToCampship) leads to the next zone instead of the campship | The real zone gate `oa_transfer_multi` is still not drawn (the client asks it `GetList`; its answer is unknown) |
| `ship_server/src/map.rs` | After the boss: a telepipe appears next to the player, a system message names the reward; using it ends the quest (campship, full HP, "Quest clear!") | `oa_telepipe_clear` was never drawn: the quest did not end |
| `ship_server/src/map.rs` | Generated quests: each enemy of a chunk gets its own spot on the player's trail (8-25 m, else 3 m+, else the player's spot), 0.3 m above the ground; layout points and the random ring are no longer used | Enemies stacked on one spot and still appeared under the floor; the client does not report enemy movement, so the fall rescue never triggers |
| `ship_server/src/battle_stats.rs` | Enemy spawn `unk9[12]` = 0 by default (the client then finds the enemy by its name); `!model` still overrides it | The value is the key of the enemy's record in the client's enemy table (memory search: 0x5DA08B21 sits in the `SoldierAnt` = Dagan record); the Dagan key for everyone made everyone a Dagan. Tested with `!model 0`: own models |
| quest 20010 objects, `ship_server/src/map.rs` | Zone gate `oa_transfer_multi` moved to the walked far end of each Forest field (121, -0.5, -155); the extra telepipes are gone. Any gate action except the client's own `GetList` leads to the next zone. The memory search runs only on `!scan` (it read an unmapped page when the boss module loaded and crashed the emulator; reads are now fault-safe too) | The gate stood at the layout transporter, 80 m past the end of the road, so it was never seen |
| `data_structs/src/map.rs`, `ship_server/src/map.rs` | `ZoneData.nova3k` (goal x/z + radius, kill count, optional boss): when the player reaches the layout's goal cell or has killed 15 enemies in the zone, the gate (`oa_transfer_multi`, plus a backup telepipe that also leads on) appears next to the player on the walked trail - or, in the last field of a quest without an arena, the zone's boss (20x HP, level +2). Boss death -> exit telepipe + reward as before. Boss HP is now multiplied at spawn (stat files are shared) | Gates for every generated field without knowing where the client puts the goal chip; a boss at the end of every quest |
| `data/quests/nova3k/*`, `data/enemies/nova3k/*` | All 15 Exploration quests rebuilt by tools/quest_gen_all.py (research repo): campship -> field 1 -> field 2 (two common-set layouts of the zone with the most native species, Darker / Dagan family left out), boss at the end of field 2 (Forest: arena 0400, Rockbear). Start = arrival transporter_universal near the lat start cell, else a spawn point there at ground height | One quest per location with several zones, own enemies and a boss |
| `ship_server/src/map.rs`, `user/handlers/server.rs`, `user/mod.rs` | Quest clear: the telepipe after the boss also sends the Quest Results packet (0x0B 0x14, rank S, kills, meseta) and marks the quest cleared; leaving the campship for the lobby then ends the quest (as abandon, without the question) | After the Forest boss the client still treated the quest as running ("abandon the quest?") |
| `ship_server/src/map.rs`, `user/handlers/object.rs`, `user/handlers/chat.rs` | Fall rescue: a player 25 m below the zone start is put back (zone reloaded at the last trail spot, or at the next start point of the layout); `!start` reloads the zone at the next start point; `!next` in a generated field first makes its gate (or end boss) appear | Coast field 1 start was under the floor, field 2 on a closed islet; the last field without enough kills had no way to its boss |
| `ship_server/src/map.rs` | The gate also spawns `oa_transporter_universal` (quest 50570 data) next to `oa_transfer_multi`; using it (an action with transfer/use/warp/move/enter/access) leads on | `oa_transfer_multi` is still not drawn; trying the other gate kind of the captured quest |
| `data/quests/nova3k/*` (tools/quest_gen_all.py) | Start = the start chip's arrival object placed in the lat grid (checked on the Forest), else the first enemy point; the zone's spawn point list = start candidates for the rescue. Coast uses layout 1242 (its tested start) for both fields | Starts under the floor / on an islet |
| `data_structs/src/map.rs`, `ship_server/src/map.rs`, quests (tools/quest_gen_all.py) | Random field shapes: `Nova3kZone.variants` = client area templates (sn_ZZZZ_NNNN.lat: chips s0/s1 ... g0/g1, plain field pieces only) with start (start chip's arrival object in the grid), goal and rescue points; each run picks one at random with a new seed (also patched into the LoadLevel zone list and the arrival telepipe; the two fields of a quest get different shapes). Used for 11 locations; Forest, Coast, Sanctum, Tokyo, Las Vegas keep their fixed layout | The fixed "common set" layouts are huge event maps (Desert: two giant stages); normal fields are built from chips and differ every time |
| `ship_server/src/map.rs` | Generated fields: no enemies before the player's first steps (the start chunk spawns when entered again); kill counter messages every 5 kills; gate / boss after 10 kills (was 15) | Enemies under the ground at the start; the boss was never found on a huge map. Also: the gate / boss appears after 8 map cells were entered (Quarry: no gate, small map) |
| quests (tools/quest_gen_all.py) | Each location's boss is its real PSO2 field boss (names from the client's placement comments): Rockbear, Fang Banther, Zeshrayda, Gwanahda, Dingele, Jagd Dingele, Caterdran, Quartz Dragon, Goron Zoran, Org Blan, Vid Giros, Minotaurgus, Hud Azure, PhantomTank, PhantomRex | The desert "boss" was a small Canadin the player hit without noticing it was the boss |
